div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 216px; height: 1px; padding-top: 63px; margin-left: 27px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
1. Corpora and splits
Ben-Sarc • BanglaSarc • BanglaSarc3
Harmonise to a binary label space
(drop BanglaSarc3 neutral)
Normalised exact-match deduplication
and label-conflict removal
Frozen stratified 80/10/10 splits,
hashed and reused everywhere

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 241px; height: 1px; padding-top: 367px; margin-left: 14px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
2. Directed transfer matrix
BanglaBERT trained on each source,
evaluated on all three targets
3 × 3 = 9 directed cells
× 10 matched seeds × 2 systems
Off-diagonal targets filtered against
the whole source corpus
Pre-model shift audit on every pair

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 241px; height: 1px; padding-top: 647px; margin-left: 27px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
3. Strategies needing no
target labels
Fast-gradient adversarial fine-tuning
Leave-one-corpus-out multi-source
Domain-adversarial training (GRL)
Source-validation threshold recalibration
Reported separately: pooled-all, which
does see target labels

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 241px; height: 1px; padding-top: 997px; margin-left: 27px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4. Target-supervised
adaptation
Fine-tune each source model on
k labelled target examples
k ∈ {0, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000}
drawn from the target train split only
Six directions × seven budgets
Recovery measured against the
target-trained reference

div.span: Checkpoint, temperature and threshold selected on source validation data only — no target test set is consulted for any selection decision • Uncertainty reported as Student-t 95% intervals across training seeds • Adversarial vs vanilla compared by exact sign-flip permutation test on matched seeds with Holm correction over the nine cells • Metrics: macro-F1, accuracy, per-class recall, ECE and Brier before and after source-fitted temperature scaling

div.div:
1. Mean macro-F1 falls from
0.847 in domain to 0.534 across
corpora: a 31.3-point loss at
0.630 retention

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 248px; height: 1px; padding-top: 330px; margin-left: 434px;

div.div:
2. The corpus scoring 0.980
in domain is the weakest source,
collapsing to 0.009 and 0.015
sarcastic-class recall

div.div:
3. Zero of nine adversarial cells
survive Holm correction; the other
label-free strategies move transfer
by 0.022 or less

4. A median of 100 labelled
target examples recovers 90% of
the target-trained reference in
five of six directions
